ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface; high-intensity (white) pixels account for approximately 5-10% of the total visible area, concentrated in stochastic point-like clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity base across both lobes. High-intensity point-clusters (speckling) are distributed stochastically across the surface with higher density near the peduncle attachment and the trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute pixel angle estimated at 55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edges; distal end of the right lobe shows macro-level irregular indentations and a jagged terminal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, with a distinct upward sweep at the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and sub-circular high-intensity pixel clusters (0.5% - 2% lobe width) across both lobes, consistent with barnacle scarring or localized depigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal high-intensity linear pixel disruptions visible on the upper-medial region of the left lobe and vertical linear markers on the central-medial right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the right lobe tip shows a significant macro-notched irregularity compared to the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white-on-black point-speckling pattern throughout the visible ventral fluke surface.
